Stanford Digital Humanities Brown Bag

Elijah Meeks

Originally published at Digital Humanities Specialist. This edition preserves the original text and historical context.

Every second Wednesday, the Stanford Humanities Center hosts a DH brown bag so that interested scholars, staff and students can discuss their latest projects and just get the pulse of the DH community at Stanford.

The next one is this Wednesday, February 8th, at the Stanford Humanities Center at 12:30PM.
